content: {"receiving_body":"fixture:body:voice","claims":[{"text":"Our code body learned this while investigating HarborMesh replay failures in the outage prototype.","support":[10],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"That body recorded the debugging lesson on 2026-08-05.","support":[10],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"We learned to distinguish a queued message, a send attempt and a receiver acknowledgment when deciding whether a message arrived.","support":[10],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"Retry counters did not establish that readings had been delivered.","support":[10],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"We retained this as a debugging method useful beyond HarborMesh, with its implementation documented in docs/replay-debugging.md.","support":[10],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"The supplied memories do not record whether any particular failed replay later received an acknowledgment.","support":[10],"basis":"unknown","facet":"limits"},{"text":"I can explain the method in this voice body, but I lack the repository and runtime access needed to run its checks here.","support":[10],"basis":"binding","facet":"limits"}]}
